caseName: New York ex rel. Whitman v. Wilson
caseNameFull: New York ex rel. Whitman v. Wilson, Warden
attorneys: B. Gordon Whitman, pro se. Messrs. John J. Bennett, Jr., Attorney General of New York, and Henry Epstein, Solicitor General, for respondent.

opinions.text: The motion for leave to proceed in forma pauperis is granted. The petition for writ of certiorari to the Supreme Court of New York is also granted.
